# oauth2_password_grant — OAuth2 password grant end-to-end flow
# Verifies: the auth layer posts grant_type=password + username/password
# (form-urlencoded) to the token endpoint, caches the issued bearer, and
# injects Authorization: <redacted> on the data exchange.
# pagination.none → 1 data exchange; events_at: events → 5 events.
# The token endpoint is handled by the auth layer (not traced as an exchange).
# The spec is loaded live from the embedded template.

exec skopos template show -o spec.yml oauth2_password_grant
replace spec.yml http://localhost:9999 $URL
exec skopos run -i spec.yml --once --trace trace.jsonl --out events.jsonl
normalize trace.jsonl
cmp trace.jsonl want_trace.jsonl
cmp events.jsonl want_events.jsonl

-- want_trace.jsonl --
{"elapsed":"<scrubbed>","iteration":1,"method":"GET","query":{"since":"<ref cursor.last_timestamp>"},"request_headers":{"Accept":"application/json, application/x-ndjson;q=0.9, */*;q=0.1","Authorization":"<redacted>"},"response_body":"body 348 bytes, object-like","started_at":"<scrubbed>","status":200,"url":"$URL_HOST/oauth2_password_grant/events"}
-- want_events.jsonl --
{"id":"evt-000001","seq_num":1,"timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}
{"id":"evt-000002","seq_num":2,"timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:01Z"}
{"id":"evt-000003","seq_num":3,"timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:02Z"}
{"id":"evt-000004","seq_num":4,"timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:03Z"}
{"id":"evt-000005","seq_num":5,"timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:04Z"}
